description:
Moradia Independente para Arrendamento de Longo Prazo Aldeias de Montoito, Redondo

Descubra esta moradia independente de arquitetura contemporânea, situada nas Aldeias de Montoito, concelho de Redondo, em plena paisagem alentejana.

**Características:**

- Moradia T2, 245 m² de área bruta

- Terreno de 3,75 hectares (37.500 m²)

- 2 casas de banho, suíte principal

- Piscina exterior de água salgada

- Painéis solares elevada eficiência energética (Classe C)

- Soalho radiante (sistema hidráulico) + ar condicionado

- Recuperador de calor novo

- Vinha própria e olival ativo

- Cozinha contemporânea em open space, grande luminosidade natural

- Total privacidade, isolamento em plena natureza

- Localização tranquila, próxima de Reguengos de Monsaraz, Évora e Alqueva

**Condições de Arrendamento:**

- Duração mínima de contrato: 6 meses

- Caução: 1 mês de renda

- Meses à cabeça: a combinar

- Fiador: avaliado caso a caso

- Não se destina a arrendamento de curta duração

Ideal para quem procura residência permanente ou arrendamento de longa duração, com privacidade total e qualidade de vida no Alentejo, sem abdicar da proximidade a Évora e à região do Alqueva.

Interessados podem contactar para agendar visita. 

Categoria Energética: C

Discover a truly unique property in the Villages of Montoito, municipality of Redondo, in the middle of the Alentejo landscape, a region recognised for its winemaking tradition, olive groves and quality of life.

This extraordinary villa of contemporary architecture, developed with a project from scratch, combines modern design, comfort, maximum energy efficiency and a perfect integration with the surrounding nature.

**Key Features**

- Building area: 245 m²

- Plot: 37,500 m² (3.75 hectares)

- Modern architecture: minimalist lines

- Premium air conditioning: underfloor heating with water system (hydraulic) and air conditioning installed

- New heat recovery

- Spacious open space: excellent natural light

- Master suite: total privacy and comfort

- Materials: high-quality premium finishes

- Kitchen: integrated contemporary design

- Swimming pool: outdoor saltwater

- Sustainability: solar panels for energy self-sufficiency

- Own vineyard: private production on Alentejo soil

- Active olive grove: functional landscape integration

- Privacy: total seclusion in harmony with nature

**A House Thought Out in Detail**

The interior stands out for its large and fluid spaces, where the open space social area creates a sophisticated and welcoming atmosphere.

Thermal comfort is guaranteed throughout the year through a state-of-the-art double solution: underfloor heating with water system, which ensures homogeneous and natural heating in winter, and air conditioning system, ideal for quick temperature regulation.

The contemporary kitchen, with natural wood finishes and elegant lines, is the heart of the house. The suite offers maximum rest, while the remaining spaces have been designed to provide functionality, luminosity and a harmonious connection to the outside.

**Exterior**

Set on a plot of 3.75 hectares, this property offers the best of country life without giving up modern comfort.

The saltwater pool, the gardens designed to the detail, the vineyard and the olive grove create an exclusive setting to enjoy the Alentejo lifestyle in complete privacy.

Ideal for permanent residence, luxury holiday home or high-end tourist investment.

**Location**

Located in Aldeias de Montoito, in the municipality of Redondo, district of Évora, it benefits from the tranquillity of the Alentejo countryside, maintaining proximity to Reguengos de Monsaraz, Évora and the region of the great lake of Alqueva.

A rare property, where architecture, nature and quality of life meet in perfect harmony. 

Energy Rating: C
